notes: *which he sprinkled*: the relative realizes the object suffix under rule 18, and the waw opening the recast clause is unrepresented, the ASV writing no separate connective. Giving *which* to the waw was the competing reading; rule 18 prefers the pronominal morpheme the relative actually resumes.
*the sacrifice of peace offerings* writes one *the*, which rule 29 fronts from the rectum's own article, the rectum itself being rendered anarthrously.
The opening waw takes the postpositive *also* under rule 51, the unit discontinuous under rule 25; distance from the waw is not evidence against it.
